devdoc.details: Uses OpenZeppelin AccessControl for role-based permissioningStores historical prices and supports both common and cut-off price updatesPerforms deviation checks to prevent extreme price manipulations

AccessControlBadConfirmation().details: The caller of a function is not the expected one. NOTE: Don't confuse with {AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount}.

OracleAdded(address,address).details: Only callable via OracleRegistry contract functions that manage oracles

params.oracle: The oracle address providing price feeds
params.token: The token address associated with the oracle

OracleRemoved(address).details: Only callable via OracleRegistry contract functions that manage oracles

params.token: The token address whose oracle is removed

OracleUpdated(address,address).details: Only callable via OracleRegistry contract functions that manage oracles

params.token: The token address whose oracle is updated

PriceUpdated(address,uint256,uint256,boo.details: Only callable by addresses with PRICE_UPDATE_ROLE

params.isCutOffPrice: Whether this price is a cut-off price
params.updatedAt: Timestamp when the price is updated

RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32.details: Emitted when `newAdminRole` is set as ``role``'s admin role, replacing `previousAdminRole` `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is the starting admin for all roles, despite {RoleAdminChanged} not being emitted to signal this.

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call. This account bears the admin role (for the granted role). Expected in cases where the role was granted using the internal {AccessControl-_grantRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

addTokenOracle(address,address).details: Only callable by ORACLE_MANAGE_ROLEReverts if token already exists or any address is zero

constructor.details: Performs zero-address checks and ensures token/oracle arrays have the same lengthInitializes initial prices and emits `PriceUpdated` events

getCutOffPrice(address,uint256).details: Reverts if price is expired or index out of bounds

returns.price_: The cut-off price for the token

getCutOffPrices(uint256).details: Reverts if price is expired or index out of bounds

returns.prices_: Array of prices for each token

getOracle(address).details: Returns zero address if token is not registered

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

getTokens().details: Useful for iterating over all tokens to fetch historical prices

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

latestCutOffPriceUpdatedAt().details: Reverts if no cut-off updates exist

onlyGetCutOffPrices(uint256).details: Useful for internal auditing or calculation

returns.prices_: Array of prices for each token

onlyPeekAt(address,uint256).details: Useful for auditing or internal calculations

peek(address).details: Performs deviation check to prevent extreme values

removeTokenOracle(address).details: Uses swap-and-pop for efficient removal from arrayOnly callable by ORACLE_MANAGE_ROLE

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

updatePrices(uint256,bool).details: Reverts if price deviates beyond tolerances or updates are too frequentUpdates all registered tokens based on their oracle feeds

params._isCutOffPrice: Whether the update is a cut-off price

updateTokenOracle(address,address).details: Only callable by ORACLE_MANAGE_ROLEReverts if token does not exist or any address is zero

ORACLE_MANAGE_ROLE.details: Only addresses with this role can call `addTokenOracle`, `removeTokenOracle`, `updateTokenOracle`Calculated as keccak256("ORACLE_MANAGE_ROLE").

PRICE_UPDATE_ROLE.details: Only addresses with this role can call `updatePrices`Calculated as keccak256("PRICE_UPDATE_ROLE").

_oracles.details: Internal mapping to track which oracle feed is used for each token

commonPriceUpdatedAt.details: Index corresponds to historical versions of price updates

cutOffPriceUpdateAt.details: Only updated when `_isCutOffPrice` is true during `updatePrices`

paramRegistry.details: Used to fetch tolerances, price update intervals, and validity durations

prices.details: Stores all historical prices for each token

tokens.details: Used for iteration during price updates and retrieving historical prices

vaultToken.details: Core token whose price is specially managed and checked against exchange rate tolerances

ConflictiveToken().notice: Thrown when a common token address conflict with the vault token address.

ExceedArrayLengthLimit().notice: Thrown when an array is reach to the length limit.

ExceedMaxDeviation().notice: Thrown when price deviation exceeds maximum allowed.

IndexOutOfBounds().notice: Thrown when an index is out of bounds.

InvalidArrayLength().notice: Thrown when array lengths do not match or are zero.

InvalidZeroPrice().notice: Thrown when a price is zero.

OracleAlreadyAdded().notice: Thrown when an oracle is already registered for an asset.

OracleNotExist().notice: Thrown when an oracle does not exist for an asset.

PriceUpdateTooFrequent().notice: Thrown when price updates are attempted too frequently.

PriceValidityExpired().notice: Thrown when a price validity period has expired.

ZeroAddress().notice: Thrown when a provided address is zero.
